notes: The regional tourism authority identifies an independently usable 1,300 m inner School course and a separate 3,100 m exterior course. The School selection retains the inner northern hairpin, diagonal return, southern training straight and narrow western connector. Exact public OSM course nodes on ways 51765218, 1007068425 and 51765219 retain the inner northern hairpin and southern training return. The missing western connector is independently digitized from the Spanish national PNOA MA orthophoto WMS. The independent OSM snapshot hash and selected way indices, image bytes, exact Web Mercator extent and request are pinned. The image acquisition year is not asserted. The Grand Prix exterior, National shortcut, pits, southeastern training skidpad and northeastern karting area are excluded. Fine alignment, travel direction and historical changes remain draft. No vertices are fitted to private diagrams, timing positions or nominal distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 1213.8 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 74 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
